title: Section
description: Represents a single section of a University of Maryland course in the umd.io API.

section_id.description: A unique section identifier, always the course_id with a four-digit section number appended to it.

semester.description: Numeric representation of the semester, in format YYYYMM.

number.description: The four-digit section number, the other half of section_id.

seats.description: The number of seats for the section.

days.description: Days of the week the section meets (combination of M, Tu, W, Th, F).

room.description: The room number the meeting is in.

building.description: The building the meeting is in.

open_seats.description: The number of open seats for the section.

waitlist.description: The number of people on the waitlist.

instructors.description: An array of professor names for the section.
